artifacts.summary: 5-phase implementation plan to close ALL Kamp theorem sorries at all depths with no axiom fallback

memory_candidates.content: For arity-climbing induction in Kamp theorem proofs (Rabinovich Section 5 P_n(k)): the key architectural insight is that depth-0 zone wiring and depth >= 2 arity-climbing are independent proof obligations. Depth-0 requires connecting VecEADecomp zone theorems to nf_eval_nf (~1000 lines mechanical). Depth >= 2 requires generalizing the bypass to arbitrary arity n so the IH at depth k (all arities) provides temporal formulas for the (n+1)-var quantifier conditions at depth k+1. The enriched formula encodes ALL quantifier conditions as explicit conjuncts, making backward extraction trivial (conjunction elimination) and avoiding the Feferman-Vaught composition problem. The ssn_order_consistent filter (12 boolean checks) is a prerequisite that must be applied BEFORE depth-0 wiring.
